app_context: Department of Consumer Affairs - Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 Compliance Enforcement System

theme.description: Clean, authoritative government portal aesthetic. Deep navy primary anchor for official dignity, crisp off-white/slate backgrounds, combined with high-contrast semantic status badges (Emerald Green for Compliant, Crimson Red for Non-Compliant/Violation, Amber Yellow for Review Required).

scale_hierarchy.h1_hero: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-none

rules: Never use pure black #000000; use slate-900 #0F172A.
Primary brand blue (#1E3A8A) reserved for primary navigation, hero header accents, and main CTAs.
Backgrounds must be slate-50/100 to reduce glare during field mobile scanning.
Semantic status badges must strictly maintain WCAG AA contrast (contrast ratio >= 4.5:1).

visual_enhancers.scan_overlay: Animated scanning pulse laser beam (#2563EB) across bounding boxes during OCR processing state

layout_and_grids.dashboard_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 sm:gap-6
layout_and_grids.repository_table_layout: Full width card with sticky column header, filter row above, and pagination footer

legal_metrology_rules_reference_data.title: Maximum Retail Price (MRP)
legal_metrology_rules_reference_data.requirement: Must be declared as 'MRP Rs. XX.XX (incl. of all taxes)'. Dual MRP or sticker overwriting prohibited except reduction.

legal_metrology_rules_reference_data.title: Net Quantity
legal_metrology_rules_reference_data.requirement: Declared in standard units (g, kg, ml, L, N). Must appear on Principal Display Panel with contrasting background.

legal_metrology_rules_reference_data.title: Manufacturer / Packer / Importer Name & Address
legal_metrology_rules_reference_data.requirement: Complete name and office address with pin code. Importer address required for imported goods.

legal_metrology_rules_reference_data.title: Month & Year of Manufacture / Packing
legal_metrology_rules_reference_data.requirement: Declared as 'Mfg Date: MM/YYYY' or 'Packed on: MM/YYYY'.

legal_metrology_rules_reference_data.title: Consumer Care Details
legal_metrology_rules_reference_data.requirement: Must include name, address, telephone number, and email address of person/office to contact in case of complaint.

legal_metrology_rules_reference_data.title: Font Height & Legibility (Table-I)
legal_metrology_rules_reference_data.requirement: Height of numerals/letters >= 1.0mm to 6.0mm depending on PDP surface area (A). Blown/molded letters require 2.0mm min.

accessibility_requirements.touch_targets: Minimum 44px by 44px for field mobile usage
accessibility_requirements.contrast: Minimum 4.5:1 for standard text, 3:1 for large display titles and badge states
accessibility_requirements.keyboard_nav: Full tab ordering across scan overlays, table filters, and modal controls
accessibility_requirements.data_test_ids: Mandatory data-testid attributes on all role buttons, upload inputs, scan triggers, filters, and report export links

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a fully demoable, highly responsive application for the Legal Metrology Compliance Checker.
Implement the role switcher prominently so hackathon evaluators can easily switch between Field Inspector, Compliance Reviewer, and Admin Officer.
Provide interactive OCR simulation on uploaded packaging images with visually annotated bounding boxes that highlight compliance pass/fail status.
Include a functional report generator preview with downloadable mock PDF and DOCX file downloads.
Ensure all interactive components (buttons, tabs, selects, table rows, file upload triggers) have explicit data-testid attributes.
Use Lucide React icons for clear official UI cues (ShieldCheck, AlertTriangle, FileText, Camera, Scan, Scale, Users, FileCheck).
Maintain high contrast and official Indian Government Department of Consumer Affairs styling tones throughout.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing_requirement: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_generic_layouts: Avoid generic centered layouts or unstyled default components. Use official government header banners, subtle depth layers, and high-visibility status tags.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.hover_contrast: Ensure explicit hover text color specification when background color changes on hover.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_emoji_icons: Use official SVG icons from Lucide React instead of emojis for system status and buttons.
